cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Could you pinch these bouquet stems together? My wedding ribbon keeps sliding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got them. You need wire underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Could you twist this bit round, just where your fingers are?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There. That sharp end will snag the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you tuck it in and wind the ribbon over it? One little bow would hide everything. I'll hold the scissors.

mechanism: A calls itself mere ribbon holder while choosing the next finishing step, using B practical corrections to shift nearly all bouquet assembly onto B.
confusable: Not helpless random requests: every tiny favor follows the actual state of the bouquet and leaves A directing completion.
comparison: Shelf installation against work deadline versus wedding bouquet finish against snag risk.
